description: Production bundle budgets: raw and gzip chunk limits plus import-boundary rules. Initial game code must exclude the renderer and compatibility physics implementation; those load through renderer warm-up. Limits retain the existing 15% tolerance. Investigate regressions before changing budgets.

forbidden.why: server, scripts and tests never ship in the game; play.html only redirects
retired lab backends, oracles and window management must not re-enter the game bundle
retired online and visibility prototypes must not re-enter the game bundle
retired terrain modules must not re-enter the game bundle
Three.js is development-only; no part of the package may ship in the game
The game must not depend on diagnostic lab modules
Renderer construction belongs behind asynchronous warm-up
Compatibility physics must not block title imports
